context: Wait for the bound run, verify its immutable head SHA and conclusion, enumerate every job whose name contains windows-latest, require each conclusion to be success, and route any unrelated platform failure to explicit tracked work before completion.
description: Workflow-dispatch run 30720867434 is bound to integrated develop SHA 952986127d5cb2b9ccd2f6867c989967e99fdbd4 after PRs #1445 and #1450 merged. Require the run to complete successfully and inspect every Windows job rather than relying on a failure-count grep.

anti_patterns.dont: Count FAILED lines through a vacuous xargs pipeline
anti_patterns.instead: Read structured run and job conclusions with gh JSON
anti_patterns.why: Missing run or job IDs can produce a false zero

anti_patterns.dont: Treat an overall workflow failure as a Windows failure without inspecting jobs
anti_patterns.instead: Separate Windows acceptance from unrelated platform triage
anti_patterns.why: The previous proof run exposed an independent macOS test race

deferrals.reason: Run 30720867434 Windows 3.12 job 91424309946 fails four PR-followup unit tests. PR #1442 added _executor_command() before the injected runner; on Windows it requires shutil.which(codex), so RecordingRunner tests unexpectedly depend on Codex being installed. Add an explicit test-only command seam and preserve production resolution.
deferrals.summary: Mock-runner executor tests depend on a real Codex binary during Windows command resolution

preserves.behavior: No Windows job is omitted by selecting only one Python version
The proof stays bound to run 30720867434 and its immutable head SHA
Unrelated platform failures are inspected and explicitly routed before completion

verifications.command: test "$(gh run view 30720867434 --json status,conclusion,headSha --jq '[.status,.conclusion,.headSha] | join(" " )')" = "completed success 952986127d5cb2b9ccd2f6867c989967e99fdbd4"
verifications.description: Bound workflow run completed successfully on the integrated develop SHA
verifications.expected: fails on the unfixed or incomplete state while run 30720867434 is queued, running, unsuccessful, or bound to a different SHA; passes only after successful completion on SHA 952986127d5cb2b9ccd2f6867c989967e99fdbd4

verifications.command: test "$(gh run view 30720867434 --json jobs --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | test("windows-latest")) | select(.conclusion != "success")] | length')" = 0
verifications.expected: fails on the unfixed tree or while any windows-latest job is queued, running, cancelled, skipped, or failed; passes only when every matching job concluded success

work_units.summary: Verify the bound run SHA and wait for completion
Enumerate every Windows job and require successful conclusions
Inspect and route any non-Windows failure
Record final run and Windows job evidence
